boundary: Independent actual handler/backend logic, memory storage, explicit documented-shape partner response fixtures. All physical network denied. This does not prove provisioned scopes, real OAuth, ordinary webhook envelope, partner configuration, provider sends or publication.

checks.name: Ordinary scheduled recovery dispatches the existing keyed background job without waiting for any model turn
Background execution rejects missing authority and foreign tenant before model or vendor writes
AI stays off without execution entitlement; enabling requires reviewed exact current rules and never replies to old imported messages
One new customer turn consumes one shared logical turn, two physical model requests and exactly one accepted native reply
Six concurrent workers for the same durable customer turn claim one generation and send once
Repeated webhook receipt while generation is in flight cannot restart that same turn
A newer customer correction discovered during model preparation prevents the stale reply
Owner takeover during model preparation wins before any native send
Global pause during model preparation wins before any native send
Changed saved business rules invalidate an in-flight proposal without sending it
Workspace replacement during model preparation cannot send or write new-tenant automation records
A person replying directly in Thumbtack during preparation prevents a second AI reply
A lost native acknowledgment stays unknown and repeated webhook or worker never sends again
A definite native rejection requires owner review and is not labeled an accepted reply
The shared daily logical allowance blocks lead AI before model transport
The tenant physical ceiling includes unknown model attempts and never retries them
An exact physical tenant ceiling rejects another model request even when logical turns remain
No-reply decision preserves the message and produces no vendor write or customer contact claim
Handoff sends one honest acknowledgment and leaves the conversation with its owner
A qualified visit request stays in this Inbox request without creating bookings, texts or tasks
A model-invented customer phone number is held instead of copied into a sent reply qualification
An unpublished price whose digits overlap a published fee is rejected
An invented customer name is not accepted as a qualified fact
A promised confirmed booking is held before provider transport
Owner pause at the last provider-read boundary wins before the native POST
Concurrent recovery of one prepared proposal claims delivery once without another model call
A stale generating checkpoint becomes owner work and never repeats a potentially consumed model call
A stale sending checkpoint becomes owner work without another native POST
Customer STOP is an authoritative no-reply and blocks later automatic conversation turns
An uncertain rotating token refresh blocks prepared delivery and is never repeated by worker replay
Multiple proposal calls cannot send the first partial choice
Manual owner reply at the 200-thread automation limit cannot corrupt the saved connection
A life-safety message cannot receive a routine visit reply or a safety script hidden after the identity prefix
An accepted life-safety handoff keeps the saved safety words first and does not promise dispatch
A saturated shared physical model budget blocks a new tenant before transport
Desktop actual owner enables AI only after review and recovers a lost saved acknowledgment without repeating the write
Mobile actual takeover and resume preserve an unsent owner draft and do not contact the customer
Mobile lost takeover receipt is checked by its same operation and retains the owner draft
Refreshing changed rules clears the earlier review checkbox before enabling AI
Session expiry during an in-flight owner change clears private panels and ignores its late response
Actual AI unknown-send view exposes no resend action and refreshes without provider reads
Quiet local polling preserves focused owner controls and ignores dirty drafts without vendor reads
A quiet saved-state response arriving after new owner typing cannot overwrite that draft or move its focus
